text.about.h2: A small studio that gives its printables away
text.about.p1: Nimbrel Studio designs printables and templates, and everything on this site is free. The rule is that a page should be easy to look at and obvious to use, so the type is big, the space is generous and every page has one job.
text.about.p2: The logo is a doorway with a spark in it. Every printable tries to be that: an easy place to walk in and start.
text.signup.p: Join the email list and we’ll tell you when something new is ready. It’s free, we won’t spam you, and you can leave any time.

faq.a: No. Every printable on this site is free to download and print.

faq.q: Do I need an account or an email address?
faq.a: No. Download the PDF and you’re done.
Everything is sized for US Letter. On A4, choose “Fit to page” in your print settings and it will print cleanly.
They are for your own use. Please don’t resell or re-upload them. Link to the page instead and your friends can download their own copy.

principles.d: No payment, no account and no email needed to download. You get the PDF and you’re done.
Each printable does one thing, like planning the year, sketching a video or tracking a result. There is nothing to learn before you start.
Everything fits US Letter paper and a regular printer. Color is a bonus, never a requirement.
